description:
President Donald Trump signed an executive order on Monday aimed at reshaping the federal government’s approach toward childhood vaccines, insisting that infants should receive fewer immunizations over a longer period despite little scientific evidence supporting such sweeping changes.

The wide-ranging order proposes reducing the total number of immunizations recommended for children in their earliest years and dividing the nation’s childhood vaccine schedule into three categories.

description:
A recent CNN poll found that 92% of adults with children under the age of 18 said that childcare is expensive. Those feelings also extend to an often-forgotten part of the childcare equation: the providers. As many Americans are evaluating what will influence their vote leading up to November, CNN Anchor and Chief Investigative Correspondent Pam Brown spoke with childcare providers in Maryland to better understand how national economic strain is trickling down to their operational costs to meet kids’ needs. Meanwhile, Denver Mayor Mike Johnston announced a new initiative to build a universal childcare system from birth to kindergarten age.

description:
Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed on Sunday described a “really warm” conversation with former President Barack Obama as the party seeks to find a path forward following last week’s bruising primary. 

During the conversation — which took place just days after El-Sayed, a progressive, narrowly defeated moderate Rep. Haley Stevens, the Democratic establishment’s preferred candidate — they discussed how to bring Democrats together to retain Michigan’s critical Senate seat in November, according to representatives for El-Sayed and Obama. 

Also, CNN's Audie Cornish discusses El-Sayed's Obama call with her CNN This Morning "group chat."

author: CNN
description:
A 7.4 magnitude earthquake was recorded Monday in western Colombia, according to the US Geological Survey (USGS), with tremors felt in several cities across the country. 

The epicenter was located in San José del Palmar, in the department of Chocó, about 280 kilometers west of Bogotá, at a depth of 107 kilometers at 7:34 a.m. local time (8:34 a.m. ET), the USGS reported. 

CNN meteorologist Derek Van Dam has the details and CNN correspondent Stefano Pozzebon describes the Colombian city that was hit the hardest. Also, Glaeldys González Calanche from International Crisis Group weighs in on the emergency response efforts.

description:
President Donald Trump said the United States is “low-keying” talks with Iran in an interview Sunday, in which he highlighted Washington’s economic pressure campaign as a key tool while strikes remain on pause.

Iran has consistently said no direct talks can take place with the US until Washington honors the agreements from an interim deal signed in June. It has, however, been negotiating with Oman on a plan for the Strait of Hormuz.

CNN's Kevin Liptak reports on Trump's "wait it out approach" on Iran negotiations. Also, CNN national security analyst Alex Plitsas, CNN global economic analyst Rana Foroohar and Bloomberg economics reporter Dina Esfandiary break down the impact of the stalled Iran negotiations.
